decision.observed_event: You want in. Two ways to play a round: settle it with one check, or play it out as twenty-one (blackjack), closest to 21 without going over. The stake is whatever you bet; the house plays 10 gp a round. Which way?

improv_read.player_bid: Sela sits and asks how to be dealt in.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit lets the dealer make the offer simple and leaves the weight of play to the player.

public_brief.objective: Seat her in a game he deals and learn how she handles risk.
public_brief.tactic: Name the game in one sentence and give her the stake and the way to play.
public_brief.visible_cue: He squares the deck as she sits; the fourth player taps the table.
public_brief.player_opening: She can name a stake and choose hands or one check.
public_brief.reply_to: ask the dealer what a lady has to do to be dealt in
public_brief.kit_focus: Keep the rules to one plain sentence and hand her the choice.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, playful humor: let the dealer's flattery play back to her

player_mood.cue: what a lady has to do

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The dealer gathers the scattered cards with one sweep and squares the deck against the wood, watching her settle into the empty chair. The fourth player taps the table twice.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Very little, for a lady who sits so prettily. At this table we play Twenty-One Coffins: come close to twenty-one without going over, and the house pays the bold. Name your stake. And tell me how you like your fortune, my lady: card by card, or all at once?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.reacts_to: card by card, or all at once?
